items.title: Celebrations in Serbia after veteran ruler Vučić loses election to student-led protest movement
items.description: The populist right-wing leader of 12 years says it is "clear" his party has lost the vote billed as a referendum on the country's future.

items.title: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile
items.description: Machado had left the country just a month before the US government seized Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro.

items.title: AI giant Anthropic unveils plans for blockbuster share listing
items.description: The company will be the first true artificial intelligence company to go public as tech firms continue to invest heavily in AI.

items.title: Chris Brown given suspended eight-month prison sentence over nightclub attack
items.description: The R&B star previously pleaded guilty to affray, after attacking a music producer with a glass bottle.

items.title: Nurse killed in attack while responding to Ebola alert in DR Congo
items.description: Local youths reportedly accused the health workers of contaminating water sources and spreading Ebola.

items.title: Australian murderer loses bid to eat Vegemite in prison
items.description: Andre McKechnie, who murdered a property developer, argued it was his right to enjoy Australian culture.

items.title: Eric Bauza, voice of Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck, dies aged 46
items.description: Bauza had voiced a number of characters in this summer's animated hit Coyote vs. Acme.

items.title: Rapper Nicki Minaj joins Trump onstage at Michigan rally
items.description: The Super Bass singer is the latest big name to campaign in Michigan, where a tight Senate race is playing out ahead of the 3 November midterms.

items.title: Deeply divided Israel braces for pivotal election
items.description: After three years of regional war, this is a battle Israel always knew was coming, writes Lucy Williamson.

items.title: Russia to host first Olympic federation world event since Ukraine invasion
items.description: The International Weightlifting Federation becomes the first Olympic federation to choose Russia to host a world championships since its invasion of Ukraine.

items.title: Suspect in deadly Paris suburb shooting sent for psychiatric observation
items.description: He will be observed to evaluate whether his "psychiatric health is compatible with pursuing his interrogation", authorities said.

items.title: Mourinho keeps Clasico midas touch 13 years on as La Liga heats up
items.description: Kylian Mbappe's two goals at Barcelona have opened up La Liga, as Jose Mourinho's Real Madrid leave Camp Nou with a victory.
